body: All 23.2 million pairs analyzed against the full reference; 28 accepted + 26 discarded hypotheses were audited. Many are repeat/normal-RNA signals. CEACAM3 noncoding and KRTAP9-1 repeat events also have DNA support; driver relevance is unproven. CCND1::HEG1 has a small antisense RNA signal and two non-exact DNA read-pair hints; microhomology and overlapping mates limit biological interpretation. No activating treatment target was established. Sparse indexing and filtering limit negative conclusions.
